programmes.d: Fantasy adventure about the legendary hero Zhong Kui, a fabled warrior with mysterious powers who is forced to conquer the realms of Heaven and Hell to save his people.

This action-packed historical epic stars martial arts legend Sammo Hung as maverick leader Commander Yu, who led a small army against hordes of invading pirates on the China coastline during the 16th century. Mandarin w/ English subtitles.

Lü Bu, general to warlord Dong Zhuo, has blazed a trail of victories on the battlefield. But when a beautiful apprentice arrives claiming to be his long-lost love, he soon realizes that his closest allies may yet be his most dangerous foes.

programmes.d: Starring Shu Qi and Based on the #1 Bestselling novels, MOJIN: THE LOST LEGEND pits a trio of grave robbers against rivals and the law, until a mysterious stranger tempts them into one last heist. In Chinese with English Subtitles.

In the final days of the Joseon Dynasty, a renowned assassin faces an inescapable fate when he crosses paths with a former swordsman and village leader. Amidst the chaos, their encounter sets in motion an epic tale of irreversible destiny.
After his clan master's death, Wu-Lin guards a wealthy family's daughter in the City of Stone-cold. When she's targeted by a gang, he fights back, uncovering a darker plot.
Tsui Hark's adaptation of Qu Bo's novel pits a Liberation Army captain against a ruthless bandit ruling Northeast China, aided by an undercover investigator.

programmes.t: Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
programmes.d: Ma dreams of making a life in Shanghai without using his fist. But when he befriends the Boss of a rival gang, he must fight for honor or lose everything.

Special agent Andrew Kang intercepts a drug shipment and goes undercover in Bangkok's criminal underworld. Posing as a cartel operative, he must gain the gang's trust, but as the lines blur, he risks losing himself—and his way out.

Two brothers compete in the world’s deadliest underground fighting tournament where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.
In this visually stunning wuxia tale, a skilled swordsman seeks redemption from his violent past by living as a vagrant, but must confront his demons when chaos disrupts his quest for peace.
